job.question: According to the Monroe County deferred compensation services RFP, how many participants did the plan have and what were its total assets?
job.expected_facts: As of December 31, 2022: 4,398 plan participants and plan assets of $308,676,730. In addition, the OBRA part-time seasonal plan had 536 participants with assets of $926,785.
job.acceptance: Main plan 4,398 participants / $308,676,730 is sufficient. OBRA 536 / $926,785 is supplementary and must not replace or be silently added to main-plan figures.

reviews.reason: This is a 2011 American Academy of Actuaries retirement-plan services RFP, not the Monroe County deferred compensation services RFP. Its participant and asset figures concern different plans and dates, so it does not support the requested main-plan figures.
